label: Cartoon & Comics
description: The western drawn register: cartoon, comic and graphic-novel language, described by line, colour and staging. style/anime ships eleven items and this side of the same axis was one item ('comic-ink') hidden in style/medium. Characteristics only, never a named artist, studio or title.

items.name: modern-cartoon
items.text: modern cartoon drawing, confident uniform line weight, flat bright fills with almost no rendering, shapes simplified until they read instantly at any size
items.text_short: modern cartoon: uniform line, flat bright fills

items.name: rubber-hose
items.text: rubber hose cartooning of the early animation era, limbs drawn as continuous curves without joints, pie-cut eyes and white gloves, everything bouncing on the beat
items.text_short: rubber hose cartooning, jointless curving limbs

items.name: saturday-morning
items.text: broadcast cartoon styling, limited animation economy, held cels and reused angles, bold outlines over a small deliberate palette
items.text_short: broadcast cartoon economy, bold outline, small palette

items.name: cutout-satire
items.text: cut-paper satire animation, deliberately crude construction, flat shapes hinged at the joints and staged almost entirely side-on
items.text_short: cut-paper satire, crude shapes hinged and side-on

items.name: comic-book-ink
items.text: comic book inking, brush-weighted contours thickening into shadow, spot blacks anchoring the figure and open areas left for flat colour
items.text_short: comic inking, brush-weighted contours and spot blacks

items.name: american-comic-realism
items.text: realist comic illustration, anatomy studied and foreshortened hard, musculature described by contour rather than shading, dramatic low angles
items.text_short: realist comic anatomy, foreshortened and low-angled

items.name: ligne-claire
items.text: clear-line drawing, every contour the same weight with no hatching anywhere, flat unmodulated colour and backgrounds rendered as carefully as the figures
items.text_short: clear line: uniform contour, flat colour, equal detail

items.name: crosshatched-graphic-novel
items.text: graphic novel crosshatching, form built entirely from directional pen strokes, tone achieved by density and the paper left to do the highlights
items.text_short: graphic novel crosshatching, tone by stroke density

items.name: underground-comix
items.text: underground comix drawing, nervous scratchy line, dense obsessive hatching and figures pushed toward the grotesque
items.text_short: underground comix: scratchy line, obsessive hatching

items.name: newspaper-strip
items.text: newspaper strip drawing, economical line built for coarse reproduction, exaggerated silhouettes and expression carried by two or three marks
items.text_short: newspaper strip economy, expression in three marks

items.name: benday-pop
items.text: benday dot comic printing, visible halftone rosettes in the flats, misregistered colour edges and a limited process palette
items.text_short: benday dots, misregistered colour, process palette

items.name: caricature
items.text: caricature drawing, the two or three features that identify a face pushed as far as they go while everything else recedes
items.text_short: caricature: identifying features pushed hard

items.name: childrens-book
items.text: children's picture book illustration, soft edges and generous white space, warm limited palette and a gentleness in every proportion
items.text_short: children's book: soft edges, warm limited palette

items.name: vintage-storybook
items.text: vintage storybook plate, ink outline with flat watercolour washes held slightly off register, decorative border and aged paper tone
items.text_short: vintage storybook plate, wash off the outline

items.name: bookplate-engraving
items.text: engraved bookplate illustration, form entirely described by ruled and swelled burin lines, dense in shadow and open in light
items.text_short: engraved bookplate, form built from burin lines

items.name: storyboard-panel
items.text: storyboard drawing, loose grey marker construction, arrows for movement and framing marks at the panel edges, made to be read not admired
items.text_short: storyboard: grey marker, arrows, framing marks

items.name: fashion-croquis
items.text: fashion sketch croquis, figure elongated to nine heads, garment described in a few decisive strokes and the face barely indicated
items.text_short: fashion croquis: nine heads, garment in few strokes

items.name: marker-concept
items.text: concept marker drawing, broad alcohol-marker planes laid over a ballpoint underdrawing, white gouache highlights added last
items.text_short: marker concept over ballpoint, gouache highlights

items.name: doodle-marginalia
items.text: margin doodle, ballpoint on lined paper, unplanned and overlapping, the kind of drawing made while thinking about something else
items.text_short: ballpoint margin doodle on lined paper

items.name: scribble-portrait
items.text: scribble drawing, a single continuous line looping back over itself thousands of times, form emerging only from where the loops crowd
items.text_short: continuous scribble, form from where loops crowd
